mchat.privacyDesc: Your answers are confidential and shared only with your assigned clinician.
mchat.privacyIntro: Before we begin, here's how we protect what you share with us.
mchat.privacyPoint1Body: Only you and your assigned clinician can view this screening.
mchat.privacyPoint2Body: All answers are encrypted in transit and at rest.
mchat.privacyPoint3Body: You can withdraw consent and delete a screening at any time.
mchat.supportingDesc: Add optional notes, photos, or audio to help your clinician.
mchat.addSupportingInfoDesc: Optional. Sharing details, photos, or a short voice note helps your clinician give a richer analysis.
mchat.notesPlaceholder: e.g. I've noticed my child making less eye contact recently...
mchat.submitConfirmMessage: Are you ready to submit your answers and any supporting info? You cannot edit them after submitting.
mchat.submissionFailedMessage: An error occurred while submitting your screening.
mchat.supportingInfoFailedMessage: Your screening was saved, but notes, photos, or voice could not be uploaded. Tap submit again to retry the upload only.
mchat.limitReachedMessage: You can only upload up to 5 pictures.
mchat.permissionRollMessage: Please grant camera roll permissions to upload images.
mchat.permissionMicMessage: Please grant microphone permissions to record audio.
mchat.incompleteMessage: Please answer all 20 questions before submitting.
mchat.successDesc: Your clinician will review the answers and prepare a personalised care plan. You'll be notified the moment it's ready.
mchat.riskDescription: Based on the M-CHAT-R/F screening for autism risk factors.
mchat.interpretation: A medium score does not mean your child has autism. It suggests that a professional evaluation is recommended. Early support has lifelong benefits.
mchat.nextStep1Body: Book a developmental specialist for a comprehensive evaluation.
mchat.nextStep2Body: Track your child's milestones and behaviours over the next few weeks.
mchat.nextStep3Body: Consider early intervention services if recommended by your doctor.
mchat.profileIntro: Review previous developmental screenings and clinician notes.
mchat.noScreeningsDesc: Submit an M-CHAT-R/F to see results here.
mchat.noSupportingInfoDesc: No additional information was submitted with this screening.
